rules.conditions: Separate legal 5/15 V operation, 20 V mis-contract, and transient clamp behavior; harness current and upstream source impedance remain independent conditions.
rules.refusal: Do not declare the complete rail safe while the receptacle, STUSB, High Diode clamp, and harness/as-built evidence remain open.

rules.conditions: Evaluate detached, dead-battery, reset, NVM-loaded, attached, hard-reset, fault, and disconnect states; distinguish generated topology from programmed NVM and measured gate waveform.
rules.refusal: Do not infer PDOs, VBEN default policy, fitted Rd state, or programmed/read-back NVM bytes without the missing primary and as-built artifacts.

rules.conditions: Use the full LED Vf/current/temperature envelope, resistor tolerance/TCR, magnetic current definition, diode polarity/waveform, ballast sharing, CTRL/PWM state, PCB thermal path, and fault behavior.
rules.refusal: Do not promote mirror-only FXL or R+O SS26 limits, assumed branch sharing, or nominal arithmetic to a guaranteed selected-stage PASS.

rules.conditions: Check V15 transients, EN-open startup, switching timing, actual V3P3 load steps, inductor heating/saturation, effective output capacitance, layout, and MCU operating state.
rules.refusal: Do not infer minimum off-time, MCU load, guaranteed MLCC capacitance, or full-load FNR thermal margin from nominal values.

rules.conditions: Evaluate NTC tolerance and R-T data, divider loading, ADC sample time/source impedance, calibration, placement/thermal lag, and actual firmware thresholds/hysteresis.
rules.refusal: Do not invent firmware thresholds or use beta-only conversion as a guaranteed full R-T curve.

rules.conditions: Trace each claim through official source, conditioned requirement, generated netlist, symbol/footprint pin map, PCB/BOM/CPL identity, as-built inspection, programmed state, and bench evidence.
rules.refusal: A completed upstream stage never implies a later as-built, programmed, or measured stage.
